name: io.github.JTraversa/corpus-cloud-pricing-mcp
title: corpusAI Cloud Pricing
description: Cloud, GPU and LLM token prices with index fixings. Pay per call over x402 or with a prepaid key.

environmentVariables.name: CORPUS_PAYER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key of a wallet with a Circle Gateway USDC balance; paid tools pay for themselves. Omit to use only the free tools.

environmentVariables.name: CORPUS_CHAIN
environmentVariables.description: Circle Gateway chain to pay on, as the Gateway SDK names it: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, unichain, sonic, worldChain, sei, hyperEvm or arc.

environmentVariables.name: CORPUS_MAX_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Spend cap per call in USDC; calls priced above it are refused.

environmentVariables.name: CORPUS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API origin; leave unset for https://cloud.trycorpus.ai.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer ck_… prepaid key for the paid tools; free tools need nothing.
